lessons: The fence misses files that import the migrated helpers. tests/unit/test_serve_scan_head.py imports `owner` from tests/unit/test_serve_idle_poll.py and sets `owner.checkout.git.status_porcelain.return_value` and `rev_parse.return_value` on that stand-in.

tests/unit/test_supervise_idle_hooks.py imports `rig` from tests/unit/test_supervise_idle_point.py and asserts `ctx.git.mock_calls == []` at line 192. That needs a mock stand-in, so the GitFake migration breaks this importer outside the fence.

Re-author the ticket and add tests/unit/test_serve_scan_head.py and tests/unit/test_supervise_idle_hooks.py to the Scope fence. Migrate their Git use to GitFake overrides and `fake.calls` assertions, keeping each test's name and assertion strength.
Before re-filing, grep tests/ for every `from tests.unit.<migrated module> import` and fence each importer that touches the helper's git. CLAUDE.md requires fencing every importer a change forces.
The rest of the attempt was sound: both Verification commands passed (3 and 114 tests). Only the 5 parametrized cases in those two unfenced importers failed the full unit gate.
